name: Sushi
description: A fully decentralized protocol for automated liquidity provision on Ethereum.

methodology.UserFees: Users pay a 0.3% fee on each trade.
methodology.Fees: SushiSwap Classic charges a flat 0.3% fee.
methodology.Revenue: A share of each trade fee goes to xSUSHI stakers.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Treasury does not receive SushiSwap Classic swap fees.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: A share of each trade fee goes to xSUSHI stakers.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Liquidity providers receive 5/6 of swap fees from trades in their pools.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by users on SushiSwap Classic pools.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by users on SushiSwap Classic pools.

Revenue.Swap Fees To xSUSHI Stakers: The 1/6 protocol fee share from SushiSwap Classic swaps.

HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees To xSUSHI Stakers: The 1/6 protocol fee share from SushiSwap Classic swaps.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Liquidity Providers: The 5/6 fee share retained by liquidity providers.

methodology.Revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders

methodology.UserFees: Users pay the pool's swap fee on every trade, from 0.01% to 1% on most chains and up to 4% on Katana
methodology.Fees: Traders pay a swap fee set per pool, from 0.01% to 1% on most chains and up to 4% on Katana
methodology.Revenue: The share of each swap fee Sushi keeps rather than paying to liquidity providers - nothing on most pools, 25% where the protocol fee is switched on, and 50% on Katana
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Sushi keeps all of its fee share, collected into a Sushi-controlled treasury wallet on each chain
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Negligible (was 38% before Mid of October 2025). SUSHI stakers stopped receiving major part of swap fees in Mid of October 2025; so no part of the fee is counted as going to holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Liquidity providers keep the rest of the swap fee in the pools they fund

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by users on SushiSwap V3 pools. Fee rates vary by pool, from 0.01% to 1% on most chains and up to 4% on Katana.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by users on SushiSwap V3 pools. Fee rates vary by pool, from 0.01% to 1% on most chains and up to 4% on Katana.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Treasury: The part of each swap fee Sushi keeps - 25% where the protocol fee is switched on, 50% on Katana.
Revenue.Swap Fees To xSUSHI Stakers: Protocol fee share routed to xSUSHI stakers through the SushiBar flow (Negligible since Mid of October 2025).

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Treasury: The part of each swap fee Sushi keeps, collected into a Sushi-controlled treasury wallet on each chain.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Liquidity Providers: Swap fees retained by liquidity providers after protocol fees.

HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees To xSUSHI Stakers: Protocol fee share routed to xSUSHI stakers through the SushiBar flow (Negligible since Mid of October 2025).

methodology.Fees: Trading fees paid by users while using Sushi Aggregator Routers.

Fees.DEX Aggregator Fees: Trading fees paid by users while using Sushi Aggregator Routers.

methodology.Fees: Builder code revenue from Hyperliquid Perps Trades.
methodology.Revenue: Builder code revenue from Hyperliquid Perps Trades.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Builder code revenue from Hyperliquid Perps Trades.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: No fees distributed to SUSHI token holders

Fees.Hyperliquid Builder Code Fees: Builder code fees paid by users on Hyperliquid trades.

Revenue.Hyperliquid Builder Code Fees: Builder code fees collected by the builder.

ProtocolRevenue.Hyperliquid Builder Code Fees: Builder code fees collected by the builder.

methodology.Fees: Accrued 1% SushiSwap V3 trading fees collected in launch token pools plus fixed gas-token fees paid per token launch.
methodology.Revenue: Sushi's share (sushiFeeBps) of accrued V3 trading fees plus fixed launch fees, which belong entirely to Sushi.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Sushi's share (sushiFeeBps) of accrued V3 trading fees plus fixed launch fees, which belong entirely to Sushi.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The remainder of accrued V3 trading fees: paid to the token creator or fee receiver, burned as launch tokens, or spent buying back the launch token, per the launch's fee disposition.

Fees.Trading Fees: Accrued 1% SushiSwap V3 trading fees collected in launch token pools, emitted as quoteCollected and tokenCollected in FeesDistributed.
Fees.Launch Fees: Fixed gas-token fee paid per new token launch; the full amount belongs to Sushi, emitted via LaunchFeesWithdrawn.

Revenue.Trading Fees: Sushi's share of accrued V3 trading fees, emitted as quoteToSushi and tokenToSushi in FeesDistributed.
Revenue.Launch Fees: Fixed launch fee retained by Sushi, emitted via LaunchFeesWithdrawn.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees: Sushi's share of accrued V3 trading fees, emitted as quoteToSushi and tokenToSushi in FeesDistributed.
ProtocolRevenue.Launch Fees: Fixed launch fee retained by Sushi, emitted via LaunchFeesWithdrawn.

SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees: Share of accrued V3 trading fees paid to the token creator (V1) or the launch's fee receiver (V2), emitted in FeesDistributed.
SupplySideRevenue.Launch Token Burns: Launch-token fees burned under the V2 burn fee disposition, emitted as launchTokenFeesBurned.
SupplySideRevenue.Launch Token Buybacks: Quote fees spent buying back and burning the launch token under the V2 buyback fee disposition, emitted as quoteUsedForBuyback.
